lines.beaver_en: Fast food again today. Burgers are the easiest.
lines.en: If you keep eating only fast food, your health will suffer.

lines.beaver_en: But it's tasty. Want some fries too?
lines.learner: 아니요, 좀 느끼해요. 저는 담백한 게 좋아요.
lines.en: No, they're a bit greasy. I like light food.
lines.roman: aniyo, jom neukkihaeyo. jeoneun dambaekan ge joayo.

lines.beaver: 사실 요즘 밥맛이 없어요. 피곤해서 그런가 봐요.
lines.beaver_en: Actually, I have no appetite lately. Maybe I'm tired.
lines.beaver_roman: sasil yojeum bammasi eopseoyo. pigonhaeseo geureonga bwayo.
lines.learner: 느끼한 것만 먹다가는 밥맛이 더 없어져요.
lines.en: If you keep eating greasy food, you'll lose more appetite.
lines.roman: neukkihan geonman meokdaganeun bammasi deo eopseojyeoyo.

lines.en: How about savory greens or grilled fish?

lines.beaver_en: Greens sometimes taste bitter, so I don't like them.
lines.en: Even if a bit bitter, they're good for you.

lines.beaver: 그리고 저는 콜라를 자주 마셔요. 목말라서요.
lines.beaver_en: And I drink cola often. Because I get thirsty.
lines.beaver_roman: geurigo jeoneun kollareul jaju masyeoyo. mongmallaseoyo.
lines.en: When you're thirsty, drink barley tea instead of cola.
No, barley tea is nutty and light.

lines.beaver: 사실 어제도 집에서 술을 좀 마셨어요.
lines.beaver_en: Actually, I drank a bit at home yesterday too.
lines.beaver_roman: sasil eojedo jibeseo sureul jom masyeosseoyo.
lines.en: How many bottles did you drink yesterday? I'm worried.

lines.beaver_en: About three bottles. That's a bit much, right?
lines.learner: 그렇게 마시다가는 큰일 나요. 몸을 소중히 하세요.
lines.en: If you keep drinking like that, it'll be serious. Take care of yourself.
lines.roman: geureoke masidaganeun keunil nayo. momeul sojunghi haseyo.

lines.beaver_en: Thanks. I'll try barley tea from tomorrow.
lines.learner: 좋아요. 내일 점심은 담백한 걸로 같이 먹어요.
lines.en: Great. Let's have something light for lunch tomorrow.
lines.roman: joayo. naeil jeomsimeun dambaekan geollo gachi meogeoyo.
